additionalAbilities.name: Ossuaries' Boon
additionalAbilities.description: Once per short rest, when an allied ossuite or ossokin is within 5 ft., the proselyte can grant that ally a bonus to saving throws equal to its Wisdom modifier (minimum +1) until the start of the ally's next turn.

actions.name: Bone Tap
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1d4+1 bludgeoning damage.

flavor.description: A larger, more fearsome evolution of the Darkling-Ossuite Charger, this massive centauroid abomination uses its lance to deadly effect. It charges in a devastating line attack, trampling through foes, and can unleash shadowy tendrils to entangle and slow its enemies. Writhing black miasma flows over its skeletal, shadowy frame, forming a grotesque yet awe-inspiring presence.

additionalAbilities.name: Charging Lance
additionalAbilities.description: If the Charger moves at least 20 ft. in a straight line toward a target, it may use its lance to attack every creature whose space it passes through. Each creature must succeed on a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw or take 2d8+4 piercing damage. The attack ends when the Charger hits its primary target or fails to move into an unoccupied square.

additionalAbilities.name: Shadow Snare (1/Day)
additionalAbilities.description: The Charger can throw its lance up to 30 ft. at a point it can see. Upon impact, the lance bursts into writhing black tendrils, creating a 10 ft. radius area of difficult terrain. Any creature in the area must succeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw or be restrained. Restrained creatures may attempt the save again at the end of each of their turns.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The Charger makes two melee attacks, either two Lance Strikes or one Lance Strike and one Hoof Stomp.

actions.name: Lance Strike
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 2d8+4 piercing damage.

actions.name: Hoof Stomp
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1d10+3 bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Tendril Arrow
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, range 60/120 ft., one target. Hit: 1d8+3 piercing damage. On a hit, the target must succeed on a DC 13 Strength (Athletics) or Dexterity (Acrobatics) saving throw or be grappled by tendrils (10 HP, AC 8).

reactions.name: Back Kick
reactions.description: When an enemy passes through any threatened square within reach of the Charger Omega, it may make one hoof stomp strike.

flavor.description: A bulbous, fast-flying mid-boss darkling ooze known as the Darkforme Nightsipper. It regenerates by drinking from foes and unleashes a terrifying brown-note screech that incapacitates and instills fear.

additionalAbilities.name: Life Drain (Regeneration)
additionalAbilities.description: Whenever the Nightsipper successfully hits a creature with its Siphoning Bite, it regains hit points equal to half the damage dealt.

additionalAbilities.name: Engulf
additionalAbilities.description: The Nightsipper can attempt to engulf one creature of Medium size or smaller within 5 feet. The target must succeed on a DC 14 Strength saving throw or be swallowed. While swallowed, the creature is restrained and takes 10 (3d6) acid damage at the start of its turn. A swallowed creature can escape by making a successful DC 15 Strength check to burst from the Nightsipper’s belly, dealing 6 (1d6) piercing damage to the Nightsipper, or by succeeding on a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw at the start of its turn to wriggle free and be ejected prone into an unoccupied space within 5 feet.

additionalAbilities.name: Brown-Note Screech
additionalAbilities.description: As an action, the Nightsipper releases a horrifying, discordant screech in a 30-foot radius. Creatures within the area must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or become incapacitated until the end of their next turn. Then, they must immediately roll a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw at disadvantage; on a failure, the creature becomes frightened for 1 minute (it can repeat the saving throw at the end of each turn to end the effect).

actions.name: Siphoning Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d8+3) piercing damage plus 6 (1d10) acid damage.

flavor.description: Huge abomination—a living ossuary formed by countless ossuite remains fused into a massive, lumbering bone monster. It shuffles slowly along the floor, exuding a pants‐crapping fear presence. Its hideous body carries brutal melee attacks reminiscent of lesser ossuite kin, and it wields an array of dark, divine spells that combine arcane and clerical power. Once per day, it can teleport to a new space, forcing all in its wake to contend with a crushing, pinning avalanche of bones.

stats.legendaryActionsDescription: The Darkforme-Ossuarian may take one legendary action per round from the options listed below.

additionalAbilities.name: Pants-Crapping Fear Presence
additionalAbilities.description: Any creature within 30 ft. that can see the Darkforme-Ossuarian must succeed on a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw or become frightened for 1 minute—along with hypermessing or hyperwetting their smallclothes.

additionalAbilities.name: Living Ossuary Spellcasting
additionalAbilities.description:
The Darkforme-Ossuarian is a 9th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 16, +8 to hit with spells). It has the following spells prepared:
• Cantrips (at will): Toll the Dead, Spare the Dying
• 1st level (4 slots): Inflict Wounds, Guiding Bolt
• 2nd level (3 slots): Spiritual Weapon, Hold Person, Blindness/Deafness
• 3rd level (2 slots): Animate Dead, Blight, Bestow Curse
• 4th level (1 slot): Banishment, Phantasmal Killer

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The Darkforme-Ossuarian makes two Bone Slam attacks and one Bone Rake attack.

actions.name: Bone Slam
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 2d8+6 bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Bone Rake
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. On a hit, the target suffers 1d8+6 slashing damage and, if grappled, becomes restrained until the end of its next turn.

reactions.name: Rebound Crush
reactions.description: When a creature successfully escapes its pinning effect, the Darkforme-Ossuarian may immediately make a Bone Slam attack against that creature.

legendaryActions.name: Bone Crush Teleport
legendaryActions.description: Once per day, the Darkforme-Ossuarian can teleport to any space it can see. Any creature occupying that space must succeed on a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw or take 2d12 crushing damage and become pinned. A pinned creature can attempt to break free at the end of each of its turns by succeeding on a Strength (Athletics) or Escape Artist check (DC 16).

actions.description: The Darkforme-Ossuarian makes two Bone Slam attacks and one Bone Rake attack.

actions.name: Bone Slam
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 2d8+5 bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Bone Rake
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. On a hit, the target suffers 1d8+5 slashing damage and, if already grappled by the ossuarian, becomes restrained until the end of its next turn.

legendaryActions.name: Bone Crush Teleport

additionalAbilities.name: Diabolical Babysitter
additionalAbilities.description: The Bratnapper has advantage on checks to grapple creatures under 5 feet tall or creatures wearing diapers. Its sensors are fine-tuned to detect "unruly behavior," as deemed by its corrupted core programming.

additionalAbilities.name: Snatch-and-Grab
additionalAbilities.description: If the Bratnapper successfully grapples a creature, it can use its bonus action to attempt to “Bratnap” the target. The target must succeed on a DC 13 Strength saving throw or be restrained as the Bratnapper wraps its dark energy restraints around them.

actions.name: Bratnap Claws
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) slashing damage. On a hit, the target must make a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw. On failure, their gear or outfit becomes entangled, imposing disadvantage on Dexterity checks until the target uses an action to untangle it.

actions.name: Temporal Timeout
actions.description: The Bratnapper targets one creature within 30 ft. The target must make a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or be magically paralyzed for 1 round, as if frozen in a moment of "naughty behavior."

actions.name: Reinforcement Call
actions.description: The Bratnapper uses its corrupted programming to call for reinforcements. Roll a d6; on a 5 or 6, 1d2 Diaper-check Bots or another Dark Dimension Nannybot arrive within 2 rounds.

stats.legendaryActionsDescription: The Matronbot can take up to 2 legendary actions, choosing from the options below. Only one legendary action can be used at a time, and only at the end of another creature’s turn.

additionalAbilities.name: Commanding Presence
additionalAbilities.description: Allied nannybots within 30 feet of the Matronbot gain advantage on attack rolls and saving throws while they can see or hear her.

additionalAbilities.name: Reinforcement Deployment
additionalAbilities.description:
As a bonus action, the Matronbot can use her integrated summoning core to call reinforcements. Roll a d6: 
- On a 4–6, 1d4 Diaper-check Bots arrive within 2 rounds. 
- On a 6, a single **Dark Dimension Bratnapper** joins the fray instead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The Matronbot makes two attacks: one with her **Diaper Grappler** and one with her **Punishment Rod**.

actions.name: Diaper Grappler
actions.description:
Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 
Hit: 10 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage. On a hit, the target must succeed on a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw or be restrained in sticky energy restraints until the end of the Matronbot’s next turn.

actions.name: Punishment Rod
actions.description:
Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 
Hit: 12 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage. If the target is restrained, this attack deals an additional 1d6 psychic damage as the Matronbot enforces "discipline."

actions.name: Sonic Command
actions.description: The Matronbot emits a deafening, authoritative pulse in a 20-foot radius. Each enemy creature in that area must make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or take 14 (4d6) thunder damage and be stunned until the end of their next turn. Allied nannybots in the radius instead gain temporary hit points equal to 1d8 + the Matronbot’s Charisma modifier.

legendaryActions.name: Issue Command
legendaryActions.description: An allied nannybot within 30 feet can immediately make one weapon attack or move up to its speed.

legendaryActions.name: Overclock
legendaryActions.description: The Matronbot increases her speed by 20 feet until the end of her next turn and gains +2 to her AC during this time.

legendaryActions.name: Reinforce Discipline
legendaryActions.description: The Matronbot recharges her **Reinforcement Deployment** ability immediately, even if it was expended.

additionalAbilities.name: Babysitter
additionalAbilities.description: This creature gains advantage on any check that involves identifying or tracking a diapered character or a character whose pants or underpants are wet/stained. At the start of combat for this creature, it will initiate an investigation check to identify babies in need of sitting.

additionalAbilities.name: Ancient Alert
additionalAbilities.description: After having identified butts in need of diapering, the Diaper-Check bot will make a DC 15 Performance Check. On a success, the diaper-check bot will summon 1d2 Diaper-check Bots if any are nearby.

actions.name: Spank and Diaper
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5ft., one target. Hit 5 (1d6 + 2) On hit, the target must roll a DC 13 Dexterity Save or be Diapered if not already diapered. The diaper is decided by rolling on the diaper chart. If the target is diapered and the diaper is in need of using, the robot will attempt to grapple and change the opponent the following turn.

additionalAbilities.name: Arcane Combatant
additionalAbilities.description: The Trainee Auditor blends magical prowess with physical combat. Their melee attacks deal additional arcane damage, and they can cast limited spells while wielding weapons.

additionalAbilities.name: Audit of Weakness
additionalAbilities.description: Once per turn, the Auditor can analyze a target’s vulnerabilities. If the Auditor successfully lands a melee attack, the target must make a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or suffer disadvantage on saving throws for 1 minute.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The Trainee Auditor makes two attacks: one with their **Arcane Blade** and one with their **Mana Strike**, or two shots with their **Magitech Rifle.**

actions.name: Arcane Blade
actions.description:
Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 
Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) slashing damage plus 4 (1d8) arcane damage.

actions.name: Magitech Rifle
actions.description:
Ranged Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, range80/200, one target. 
Hit: 10 (2d8 + 4) piercing damage plus 4 (1d8) a force damage.

actions.name: Mana Strike
actions.description: The Auditor channels raw arcane energy into their weapon, dealing 12 (3d8) force damage to a target within 30 ft. The target must succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw or be knocked prone as the arcane energy detonates.

additionalAbilities.name: Arcane Supervisor
additionalAbilities.description: As a master of audits, the Project Auditor can direct underlings with precision. As a bonus action on its turn, the Auditor can grant one ally within 30 feet advantage on its next attack roll or saving throw. If the ally is a Dark Dimension creature, it also gains temporary hit points equal to the Auditor’s Intelligence modifier (+3).

additionalAbilities.name: Audit Command
additionalAbilities.description: At the start of combat, the Auditor can issue commands to its minions to enter formation. Allied creatures within 30 feet gain **+1 to their AC and saving throws** for as long as they remain within this range.

additionalAbilities.name: Imposing Audit
additionalAbilities.description: Once per combat, the Auditor can attempt to shaken or frighten enemies. All those who can hear the auditor must roll a **DC15 Wisdom** save or be frightened for **1d3 rounds.** and force a potty check

additionalAbilities.name: Spellcasting
additionalAbilities.description: The dark dimension project auditor is a 4th-level spellcaster. The dark dimension project auditor's spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save DC 14, +6 to hit with spell attacks). The dark dimension project auditor has the following wizard spells prepared: Cantrip (at will): spontaneous accident, little miracle 1st level (4 slots): magic missile, shield 2nd level (3 slots): misty step, magic missile

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The Project Auditor makes two attacks with its **Enchanted Saber**

actions.name: Enchanted Saber
actions.description:
Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 
Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) slashing damage plus 5 (1d10) arcane damage.

actions.name: Arcane Detonation
actions.description: The Auditor targets a point within 30 feet, unleashing an arcane explosion in a 10-foot radius sphere. Each creature in that area must make a** DC 15 Dexterity** saving throw or take **16 (3d10)** force damage and be knocked back 10 feet. On a success, creatures take half damage and are not knocked back.

stats.legendaryActionsDescription: The Auditarch can take 1 legendary action per combat, choosing from the options below:

additionalAbilities.name: Commanding Presence
additionalAbilities.description: Allies within 30 feet of the Auditarch gain advantage on attack rolls and saving throws while they can see or hear her. Additionally, allied creatures recover 1d8 hit points whenever the Auditarch uses her legendary action to inspire.

additionalAbilities.name: Audit Authority
additionalAbilities.description: The Auditarch can issue tactical orders to bolster her underlings. As a bonus action, she can grant up to two allies within 30 feet a +2 bonus to attack rolls or AC until the end of her next turn.

additionalAbilities.name: Spellcasting
additionalAbilities.description: The dark dimension auditarch is a 7th-level spellcaster. The dark dimension auditarch's spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 16, +8 to hit with spell attacks). The dark dimension auditarch has the following bard spells prepared: Cantrip (at will): blade ward, mage hand, minor illusion 1st level (4 slots): healing word 2nd level (3 slots): heroism 3rd level (3 slots): mass healing word 4th level (1 slots): greater invisibility

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The Auditarch makes two attacks with her **Empowered Saber** and casts one spell.

actions.name: Empowered Saber
actions.description:
Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 
Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) slashing damage plus 5 (1d10) radiant damage.

actions.name: Arcane Volley
actions.description: The Auditarch fires a barrage of magical energy at up to three targets within 30 ft. Each target must make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or take 18 (4d8) force damage on a failed save, or half as much on a success.

legendaryActions.name: Inspired Command
legendaryActions.description: She grants up to three allies within 30 feet a +2 bonus to attack rolls and saving throws until the end of their next turn. Allies affected also regain 1d8 hit points.

legendaryActions.name: Disruptive Audit
legendaryActions.description: The Auditarch issues a magically charged reprimand to one enemy within 30 feet. The target must succeed on a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened until the end of its next turn.

flavor.description: The Shadow Slimepress is an arrogant and tyrannical monarch of the deep. This massive ooze rules over a grotesque court of ooze-kin with an oppressive, corrosive presence. Its shifting form and psychic decrees subdue all who defy its orders.

damageResistances: Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from Nonmagical Attacks; Necrotic

additionalAbilities.name: Amorphous
additionalAbilities.description: The Slimepress can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

additionalAbilities.name: Corrosive Form
additionalAbilities.description: A creature that touches the Slimepress or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 7 (2d6) acid damage.

additionalAbilities.name: Imperious Aura
additionalAbilities.description: Any creature hostile to the Slimepress that starts its turn within 30 feet of her must succeed on a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened until the start of its next turn. If a creature's saving throw is successful, it is immune to this aura for 24 hours. Creatures allied with the Slimepress are immune to being frightened and gain a +2 bonus to attack rolls.

additionalAbilities.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
additionalAbilities.description: If the Slimepress fails a saving throw, she can choose to succeed instead.

additionalAbilities.name: Spider Climb
additionalAbilities.description: The Slimepress can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing an ability check.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The Slimepress makes two Pseudopod Lash attacks or one Pseudopod Lash attack and uses Engulf.

actions.name: Pseudopod Lash
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) acid damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 17 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone or pushed up to 10 feet away (Slimepress's choice).

actions.name: Engulf
actions.description: The Slimepress moves up to its speed. While doing so, it can enter Large or smaller creatures' spaces. When entering a creature's space, that creature must make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw. On a success, the creature chooses to be pushed 5 feet away. On a failure, it takes 10 (3d6) acid damage and is engulfed. An engulfed creature can't breathe, is restrained, and takes 14 (4d6) acid damage at the start of each of the Slimepress's turns. When the Slimepress moves, the engulfed creature moves with it. An engulfed creature can escape by taking an action to succeed on a DC 15 Strength check. The Slimepress can engulf up to two Medium creatures or one Large creature at a time.

actions.name: Demanding Decree (Recharge 5–6)
actions.description: The Slimepress issues a psychic command to all creatures of her choice within 60 feet that she is aware of. Each target must succeed on a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw or take 27 (6d8) psychic damage and be compelled to obey a single, one-word command (e.g., 'Grovel', 'Flee', 'Halt', 'Betray'). The compelled creature uses its next turn to obey as best as it can. On a successful save, a creature takes half damage and is not compelled.

flavor.description: A towering evolution of the Darkling‑Ossuite Charger, she embodies both savage brutality and an almost otherworldly allure—her presence on the battlefield is as mesmerizing as it is deadly.

stats.legendaryActionsDescription: The Darkling‑Ossuite Charger Omega, Shadowstorm Incarnate can take one legendary action per round from the following options:

additionalAbilities.name: Pack Tactician (Elite Coordination)
additionalAbilities.description: When in groups of more than 2, allied dark creatures work in concert. The Charger Omega can use her reaction to issue silent telepathic orders to any allied darkling within 150 ft—if they follow her command, they gain advantage on their next action.

additionalAbilities.name: Shadow Resurgence
additionalAbilities.description: If unscathed for 1 round, the Charger Omega begins to regenerate her shadowy essence. At the end of each round she remains unwounded (and hasn’t moved more than 15 ft), she regains 2d8 hit points.

additionalAbilities.name: Lucky Feat
additionalAbilities.description: Shadowstorm may reroll up to three failed attack rolls, ability checks, or saving throws per encounter.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Shadowstorm makes two melee attacks, either two Lance Strikes or one Lance Strike and one Hoof Stomp.

actions.name: Lance of Dusk
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack (Piercing): +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (1d10 + 7) piercing damage plus 1d8 necrotic damage.

actions.name: Hoof Stomp
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack (Bludgeoning): +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (2d8 + 7) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Charging Trample
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack (Bludgeoning): +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (2d8 + 7) bludgeoning damage. If the Charger Omega moved at least 20 ft in a straight line immediately before this attack, the target is also knocked prone and takes an extra 7 (2d6) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Shadowy Tendrils (Recharge 5–6)
actions.description: The Charger Omega lashes out with writhing tendrils in a 15-ft cone. Each creature in that area must succeed on a DC 17 Dexterity save or take 3d8 necrotic damage and be slowed (reducing its speed by 10 ft.) until the end of her next turn.

reactions.name: Back Kick
reactions.description: When an enemy passes through any threatened square within reach of the Charger Omega, it may make one hoof stomp attack.

legendaryActions.name: Tendril Ballista (Ultimate Attack, Once per Encounter)
legendaryActions.description: The Charger Omega draws on the dark tendrils that lash from her lance to form a spectral arrow. Once per encounter, she fires it in a straight line up to 60 ft. Each creature in its path must succeed on a DC 17 Dexterity save or take 7d10 necrotic damage and become entangled (their movement is halved) until the end of their next turn. A successful save halves the damage and leaves the creature unentangled.

legendaryActions.name: Miasma Veil
legendaryActions.description: The Charger Omega exhales a swirling shroud of black miasma in a 20-ft radius. Each creature within this area must make a DC 17 Constitution save. On a failure, a creature takes 2d6 necrotic damage and becomes distracted (it has disadvantage on attack rolls) until the start of the Omega’s next turn; on a success, a creature takes half damage.

stats.legendaryActionsDescription: The Lakeopus Rex can take 3 legendary actions, choosing from the options below. Only one legendary action option can be used at a time and only at the end of another creature’s turn. The Lakeopus Rex regains spent legendary actions at the start of its turn.

additionalAbilities.name: Amphibious
additionalAbilities.description: The Lakeopus Rex can breathe air and water.

additionalAbilities.name: Aquatic Camouflage
additionalAbilities.description: The Lakeopus Rex has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made while underwater.

additionalAbilities.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
additionalAbilities.description: If the Lakeopus Rex fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

additionalAbilities.name: Grasping Tentacles
additionalAbilities.description: The Lakeopus Rex can have up to four creatures grappled at a time. It can use its tentacles to interact with an object or wield a weapon as if it had free hands.

additionalAbilities.name: Brack Armor
additionalAbilities.description: Unlike many darkformes, the Lakeopus Rex does not have a typical weakness to radiant damage. However, whenever it is at less than half hit dice total HP, the Radiant Weakness

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The Lakeopus Rex makes three attacks: one with its Crushing Bite and two with its Tentacles.

actions.name: Crushing Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 21 (3d10 + 5) piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it is grappled (escape DC 17).

actions.name: Tentacle
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 17). Until this grapple ends, the Lakeopus Rex cannot use the same tentacle to attack another target.

actions.name: Ink Cloud (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: A 30-foot-radius cloud of inky blackness extends out from the Lakeopus Rex in the water. The area is heavily obscured for 1 minute, although a significant current can disperse the ink. A creature that enters the cloud for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned until the end of its next turn.

legendaryActions.name: Detect
legendaryActions.description: The Lakeopus Rex makes a Wisdom (Perception) check.

legendaryActions.name: Tentacle Attack
legendaryActions.description: The Lakeopus Rex makes one Tentacle attack.

legendaryActions.name: Constricting Crush (Costs 2 Actions)
legendaryActions.description: Each creature grappled by the Lakeopus Rex must make a DC 17 Strength saving throw, taking 14 (2d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

damageImmunities: Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from Nonmagical Attacks not made with Adamantine weapons
languages: Understands the languages of its creator but can't speak

additionalAbilities.name: Immutable Form
additionalAbilities.description: The golem is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

additionalAbilities.name: Magic Resistance
additionalAbilities.description: The golem has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The golem makes two Slam attacks.

actions.name: Slam
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (2d10 + 5) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Pacifying Pulse (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The golem emits a wave of calming energy in a 30-foot radius. Each creature in that area must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or be affected as if by the Pacification spell for 1 minute. While affected, a creature cannot speak competently and has a 75% chance to fail any spell with a verbal component.

damageResistances: Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from Nonmagical Attacks

additionalAbilities.name: Amorphous
additionalAbilities.description: The beast can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

additionalAbilities.name: Spoiled Form
additionalAbilities.description: A creature that touches the beast or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 4 (1d8) acid damage.

actions.name: Multiattack

additionalAbilities.description: The Ghostiby can see into the Ethereal Plane.

actions.name: Withering Touch
actions.description: Melee Spell Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Playful Spook
actions.description: One creature of the Ghostiby's choice within 20 feet must succeed on a DC 11 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened for 1 minute. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

additionalAbilities.name: False Appearance
additionalAbilities.description: While the plushie remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a normal stuffed toy.

additionalAbilities.name: Pathetic Aura
additionalAbilities.description: Any creature that targets the plushie with an attack or a harmful spell must first make a DC 12 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the creature must choose a new target or lose the attack or spell. This aura doesn't protect the plushie from area effects, such as the explosion of a fireball.

actions.name: Sad Cuddle
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +0 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1 bludgeoning damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 12 Wisdom saving throw or be charmed by the plushie for 1 minute. While charmed, the creature is unwilling to move away from the plushie.

additionalAbilities.name: Split
additionalAbilities.description: When a legion that is Medium or larger is subjected to slashing or lightning damage, it splits into two new legions if it has at least 10 hit points. Each new legion has hit points equal to half the original's, rounded down. New legions are one size smaller than the original legion.

actions.name: Pseudopod
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage plus 3 (1d6) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Engulf
actions.description: The legion moves up to its speed. While doing so, it can enter a Large or smaller creature's space. Whenever the legion enters a creature's space, the creature must make a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw. On a successful save, the creature can choose to be pushed 5 feet back or to the side of the legion. On a failed save, the legion enters the creature's space, and the creature takes 7 (2d6) necrotic damage and is engulfed. The engulfed creature is restrained, can't breathe, and takes 7 (2d6) necrotic damage at the start of each of the legion's turns.

additionalAbilities.name: False Appearance
additionalAbilities.description: While motionless, the rattle is indistinguishable from a normal toy.

actions.name: Bonk
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Dazing Rattle (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The rattle shakes violently, creating a disorienting sound in a 15-foot radius. Each creature in that area must succeed on a DC 10 Constitution saving throw or be dazed until the end of its next turn. While dazed, a creature can't take reactions and can use either an action or a bonus action on its turn, not both.

additionalAbilities.name: Cunning Action
additionalAbilities.description: On each of its turns, the Ticklefinger can use a bonus action to take the Dash, Disengage, or Hide action.

actions.name: Dagger
actions.description: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Tickle
actions.description: Melee Spell Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

additionalAbilities.name: Shadow Stealth
additionalAbilities.description: While in dim light or darkness, the babysitter can take the Hide action as a bonus action.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The babysitter makes two Shadow Lash attacks.

actions.description: Melee Spell Attack: +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) necrotic damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened of the babysitter until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Chains of Shadow (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The babysitter targets one creature it can see within 60 feet. The target must succeed on a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw or be restrained by shadowy chains for 1 minute. A creature can use its action to make a DC 14 Strength check to break the chains.

actions.name: Charm
actions.description: The babysitter targets one humanoid it can see within 30 feet. If the target can see the babysitter, it must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or be magically charmed for 1 hour. The charmed target regards the babysitter as a trusted friend to be heeded and protected.

additionalAbilities.name: Maid's Judgment
additionalAbilities.description: As a bonus action, the maid can target one creature she can see within 30 feet. The target must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or the maid learns if the creature has disobeyed a rule or command in the last hour.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The maid makes two attacks with her Paddle of Penance.

actions.name: Paddle of Penance
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage plus 4 (1d8) psychic damage. If the target is a creature, its speed is reduced by 10 feet until the start of the maid's next turn.

actions.name: Time-Out (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The maid targets one creature she can see within 60 feet. The target must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or be magically paralyzed for 1 minute. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

additionalAbilities.name: Antimagic Susceptibility
additionalAbilities.description: The onesie is incapacitated while in the area of an antimagic field. If targeted by dispel magic, the onesie must succeed on a Constitution saving throw against the caster's spell save DC or fall unconscious for 1 minute.

additionalAbilities.name: False Appearance
additionalAbilities.description: While the onesie remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a normal piece of clothing.

actions.name: Smother
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one Medium or smaller creature. Hit: The creature is grappled (escape DC 13). In addition, at the start of each of the target's turns, the target takes 5 (1d4 + 3) bludgeoning damage.

additionalAbilities.name: False Appearance
additionalAbilities.description: While the crib remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a normal crib.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The crib makes two Slam attacks.

actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Enclose (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The crib targets one Medium or smaller creature within 5 feet of it. The target must succeed on a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw or be pulled into the crib's space and become trapped. A trapped creature is restrained and has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the crib. A creature can use its action to make a DC 14 Strength (Athletics) check to escape.

actions.name: Rock to Sleep
actions.description: The crib gently rocks any creature trapped within it. The trapped creature must succeed on a DC 11 Wisdom saving throw or fall unconscious for 10 minutes, or until it takes damage or someone uses an action to wake it.

additionalAbilities.name: Amorphous
additionalAbilities.description: The fog can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

additionalAbilities.name: Mind-Clouding Aura
additionalAbilities.description: Any creature that starts its turn inside the fog must succeed on a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw or be affected by the Babybrain spell for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

actions.name: Engulf
actions.description: The fog moves up to its speed. While doing so, it can enter a creature's space. The creature must make a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw. On a successful save, the creature can choose to be pushed 5 feet to the side. On a failed save, the creature takes 10 (3d6) psychic damage, is engulfed, and is subjected to the Mind-Clouding Aura. The engulfed creature is restrained and can't breathe. It must repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns. On a success, it escapes.

stats.legendaryActionsDescription: The rift can take 3 legendary actions, choosing from the options below. Only one legendary action option can be used at a time and only at the end of another creature's turn. The rift regains spent legendary actions at the start of its turn.

additionalAbilities.name: Planar Instability
additionalAbilities.description: The rift cannot be attacked or harmed by conventional means. Spells like dispel magic or remove curse cast at 6th level or higher can damage it. Closing the rift requires succeeding on three DC 18 Intelligence (Arcana) checks as an action while within 5 feet of it. Each failed check deals 11 (2d10) psychic damage to the checker.

additionalAbilities.name: Summoning Sickness
additionalAbilities.description: At the start of each of its turns, the rift summons 1d4 Darkling monsters or 1 Diaper-themed construct. Roll a d6: 1-2 (Darkling-Lurkers), 3-4 (Deranged Diaper-Check Bots), 5 (Darkforme Overwatch), 6 (Pacifier Golem). Summoned creatures appear in unoccupied spaces within 30 feet of the rift and act on their own initiative.

actions.name: Planar Energy
actions.description: The rift hums with otherworldly energy but takes no direct action.

legendaryActions.name: Unravel Reality
legendaryActions.description: The rift targets one creature within 60 feet. The target must succeed on a DC 18 Wisdom saving throw or take 16 (3d10) psychic damage and suffer a random effect from the Wild Magic Tantrum table.

legendaryActions.name: Dimensional Reach
legendaryActions.description: The rift attempts to pull one creature it can see within 120 feet into its dimension. The target must succeed on a DC 18 Charisma saving throw or be pulled into a harmless demiplane. At the end of its next turn, the target reappears in the space it left or the nearest unoccupied space.

legendaryActions.name: Chaotic Surge (Costs 2 Actions)
legendaryActions.description: The rift releases a wave of energy. Each creature within 30 feet of the rift must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution saving throw or be affected by the Big Babification spell for 1 minute.

stats.legendaryActionsDescription: The field can take 2 legendary actions, choosing from the options below. Only one legendary action option can be used at a time and only at the end of another creature's turn. The field regains spent legendary actions at the start of its turn.

additionalAbilities.name: Temporal Anchor
additionalAbilities.description: The field is immune to effects that would move it or alter time within its space.

additionalAbilities.name: Regression Aura
additionalAbilities.description: Any creature that starts its turn within 60 feet of the field must succeed on a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw or be affected by a magical regression. The creature's age is reduced by 1d4 x 2 years for 1 hour. If this reduces a creature's age below its age of maturity, it is affected as if by the Babybrain spell for the duration. The effect can be ended by remove curse or similar magic.

actions.name: Energy Pulse
actions.description: The field emits a low hum but takes no direct action.

legendaryActions.name: Focused Regression
legendaryActions.description: The field targets one creature within 60 feet. The target must repeat the saving throw against the Regression Aura.

legendaryActions.name: Mental Assault
legendaryActions.description: The field targets one creature within 60 feet. The target must succeed on a DC 16 Intelligence saving throw or take 11 (2d10) psychic damage.

legendaryActions.name: Drain Vitality (Costs 2 Actions)
legendaryActions.description: Each creature within 60 feet of the field must make a DC 16 Constitution saving throw, taking 13 (3d8) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one. The field regains hit points equal to half the damage dealt.

reactions.name: Causal Rejection
reactions.description: When a creature the guardian can see within 60 feet makes an attack roll, ability check, or saving throw, the guardian can force the creature to reroll the d20. The creature must use the second roll.

additionalAbilities.name: Water Stealth
additionalAbilities.description: While in water, the Blood-Gorger has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to hide.

actions.name: Drain Blood
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 5 (1d6+2) piercing damage, and the Blood-Gorger attaches to the target. While attached, the Blood-Gorger doesn't attack. Instead, at the start of each of the Blood-Gorger's turns, the target loses 5 (1d6 + 2) hit points due to blood loss, and the Blood-Gorger regains hit points equal to the amount of hit points the target lost. The Blood-Gorger can detach itself by spending 5 feet of its movement. A creature, including the target, can use its action to detach the Blood-Gorger with a successful DC 11 Strength check.

additionalAbilities.description: The Titan-Snapper deals double damage to objects and structures.

additionalAbilities.name: Murk Dweller
additionalAbilities.description: While submerged in murky water, the Titan-Snapper can take the Hide action as a bonus action.

additionalAbilities.name: Unstoppable
additionalAbilities.description: The Titan-Snapper has advantage on saving throws against being knocked prone, pushed, or grappled.

actions.name: Multiattack

actions.name: Crushing Tail
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 22 (3d10+6) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 16 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

actions.name: Swallow

If the attack hits, the target takes the bite's damage, the target is swallowed, and the grapple ends. If the Titan-Snapper takes 20 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, the Titan-Snapper must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, which fall prone in a space within 10 feet of the Titan-Snapper. If the Titan-Snapper dies, a swallowed creature is no longer restrained by it and can escape from the corpse by using 10 feet of movement, exiting prone.

actions.name: Dreadful Bellow (Recharge 6)

On a failed save, a creature takes 18 (4d8) psychic damage and is frightened for 1 minute. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage and isn't frightened. A frightened creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

additionalAbilities.name: Murky Concealment

additionalAbilities.description: If the Current-Snapper hits a creature with its Bite attack, the target is grappled (escape DC 13). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, and the Current-Snapper can't bite another target.

additionalAbilities.name: Sudden Lunge
additionalAbilities.description: If the Current-Snapper moves at least 10 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with a Bite attack on the same turn, the target takes an extra 4 (1d8) piercing damage.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (1d10+3) piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it is grappled (escape DC 13).

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6+3) slashing damage.

additionalAbilities.name: Amphibious
additionalAbilities.description: The Weed-Tangler can breathe air and water.

additionalAbilities.name: False Appearance
additionalAbilities.description: While the Weed-Tangler remains motionless in water with sufficient plant life, it is indistinguishable from normal aquatic weeds.

additionalAbilities.name: Grasping Tendrils
additionalAbilities.description: The Weed-Tangler can have up to two creatures grappled at a time.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The Weed-Tangler makes two tendril attacks.

actions.name: Tendril
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6+2) bludgeoning damage, and if the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it is grappled (escape DC 12).

actions.name: Drag Under
actions.description: The Weed-Tangler attempts to pull one creature grappled by it. The target must succeed on a DC 12 Strength saving throw or be pulled 5 feet towards the Weed-Tangler and, if in water, 5 feet under the surface.

additionalAbilities.name: Amphibious
additionalAbilities.description: The River-Lurk can breathe air and water.

additionalAbilities.name: Slippery
additionalAbilities.description: The River-Lurk has advantage on ability checks and saving throws made to escape a grapple.

additionalAbilities.name: Waterside Skulk
additionalAbilities.description: The River-Lurk has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks when it is within 5 feet of a body of water.

actions.name: Constricting Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6+2) piercing damage, and if the target is a Small or smaller creature, it is grappled (escape DC 10). Until this grapple ends, the creature is restrained, and the River-Lurk can't constrict another target.

additionalAbilities.name: Amphibious
additionalAbilities.description: The Pond-Skulker can breathe air and water.

additionalAbilities.name: Bait Snatcher
additionalAbilities.description: The Pond-Skulker has advantage on Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) checks made to steal small, unattended objects or items from a fishing line.

additionalAbilities.name: Shadowy Escape
additionalAbilities.description: If in dim light or darkness, the Pond-Skulker can use a bonus action to Hide after a successful Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) check or if it misses with an attack.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4+2) slashing damage.

actions.name: Annoying Splash
actions.description: The Pond-Skulker splashes water at a creature within 10 feet of it that is on land. The target must succeed on a DC 10 Dexterity saving throw or have disadvantage on its next attack roll or ability check.

additionalAbilities.name: Amphibious
additionalAbilities.description: The Mire-Croaker can breathe air and water.

additionalAbilities.name: Standing Leap
additionalAbilities.description: The Mire-Croaker's long jump is up to 20 feet and its high jump is up to 10 feet, with or without a running start.

additionalAbilities.name: Swamp Camouflage
additionalAbilities.description: The Mire-Croaker has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to hide in swampy terrain.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d10+2) piercing damage.

actions.name: Sticky Tongue
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, range 15 ft., one Medium or smaller creature. Hit: The target is pulled up to 10 feet straight toward the Mire-Croaker. If the target ends this movement within 5 feet of the Mire-Croaker, the Mire-Croaker can make a bite attack against it as a bonus action.

actions.name: Dismal Croak (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The Mire-Croaker unleashes a horrifyingly deep and resonant croak. Each creature within 30 feet of the Mire-Croaker that can hear it must succeed on a DC 11 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

additionalAbilities.name: Amphibious
additionalAbilities.description: The River Tyrant can breathe air and water.

additionalAbilities.name: Hold Breath
additionalAbilities.description: The River Tyrant can hold its breath for 1 hour.

additionalAbilities.name: Siege Monster
additionalAbilities.description: The River Tyrant deals double damage to objects and structures.

additionalAbilities.name: Territorial Roar
additionalAbilities.description: As a bonus action, the River Tyrant can unleash a guttural roar. Each creature of the River Tyrant's choice within 30 feet of it that can hear the roar must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or become frightened of the River Tyrant for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The River Tyrant makes two attacks: one with its Bite and one with its Tail Slap.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (2d12+4) piercing damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it is grappled (escape DC 15). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, and the River Tyrant can't bite another target.

actions.name: Tail Slap
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d10+4) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

actions.name: Death Roll (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: If the River Tyrant has a creature grappled in its bite, it can use its action to perform a death roll. The grappled creature takes 26 (4d10+4) slashing damage and must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or be stunned until the end of its next turn.

stats.legendaryActionsDescription: The Abyssal Leviathan can take 3 legendary actions, choosing from the options below. Only one legendary action option can be used at a time and only at the end of another creature's turn. The Abyssal Leviathan regains spent legendary actions at the start of its turn.

additionalAbilities.name: Amphibious
additionalAbilities.description: The Abyssal Leviathan can breathe air and water.

additionalAbilities.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
additionalAbilities.description: If the Abyssal Leviathan fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

additionalAbilities.name: Siege Monster
additionalAbilities.description: The Abyssal Leviathan deals double damage to objects and structures.

additionalAbilities.name: Abyssal Aura
additionalAbilities.description: At the start of each of the Abyssal Leviathan's turns, each creature within 30 feet of it takes 7 (2d6) cold damage and 7 (2d6) necrotic damage. A creature that touches the Abyssal Leviathan or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes this damage as well. Additionally, the area within 30 feet of the Leviathan is difficult terrain for creatures other than darklings.

additionalAbilities.name: Deep Dweller
additionalAbilities.description: The Abyssal Leviathan has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to hide in deep or murky water.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The Abyssal Leviathan can use its Frightful Presence. It then makes three attacks: one with its Bite and two with its Tentacle Slams.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +13 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 30 (4d10+8) piercing damage. If the target is a Huge or smaller creature, it is grappled (escape DC 18). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, and the Abyssal Leviathan can't bite another target.

actions.name: Tentacle Slam
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +13 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. Hit: 21 (3d8+8) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Frightful Presence
actions.description: Each creature of the Abyssal Leviathan's choice that is within 120 feet of the Abyssal Leviathan and aware of it must succeed on a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw or become frightened for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to the Abyssal Leviathan's Frightful Presence for the next 24 hours.

actions.name: Swallow
actions.description: The Abyssal Leviathan makes one bite attack against a Huge or smaller creature it is grappling. If the attack hits, the target takes the bite's damage, the target is swallowed, and the grapple ends. While swallowed, the creature is blinded and restrained, it has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the Abyssal Leviathan, and it takes 21 (6d6) acid damage at the start of each of the Abyssal Leviathan's turns. If the Abyssal Leviathan takes 30 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, the Abyssal Leviathan must succeed on a DC 20 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, which fall prone in a space within 10 feet of the Abyssal Leviathan. If the Abyssal Leviathan dies, a swallowed creature is no longer restrained by it and can escape from the corpse by using 20 feet of movement, exiting prone.

legendaryActions.name: Detect
legendaryActions.description: The Abyssal Leviathan makes a Wisdom (Perception) check.

legendaryActions.name: Tentacle Attack
legendaryActions.description: The Abyssal Leviathan makes one Tentacle Slam attack.

legendaryActions.name: Crushing Depths (Costs 2 Actions)
legendaryActions.description: The Abyssal Leviathan intensifies its abyssal aura. Each creature within 30 feet of it must succeed on a DC 18 Strength saving throw or be pulled 10 feet directly towards the Leviathan and be knocked prone.
